fusions.name: Darkened Sky
fusions.desc: Looses 5 barbs at once in a wide spread, each dealing 4 piercing damage. Your afflictions on the enemies they hit spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Stripping Bite
fusions.desc: A gnawing strike that deals 7 damage and leaves the target 10% easier to wound for 4 seconds and [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds. Holds 5 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Loosed Plague
fusions.desc: Releases a swarm for 8 seconds that strikes enemies within 4 tiles for 2 damage every second.

fusions.name: Stripped Bare
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, you regain 3 health a second for 4 seconds. Once every 6 seconds.
